title: of Sh8 million. The support
columns:
Sanlam
supports
the Covid
Emergency
Fund Kitty
Sanlam Kenya boosted the
Kenya Covid-19 Emergency
Response Fund to the tune
of Sh8 million. The support
to the fund was in light of
the unprecedented crisis,
necessitating the country to
embark on a large-scale health
and social behavior-change
intervention.
The funds from Sanlam and
its Kenyan entities (Sanlam
Life, Sanlam General, Sanlam
Investments East Africa and
Saham Kenya) supported the
government’s efforts in the
supply of medical facilities
and equipment and support
for vulnerable communities
with their immediate needs,
including food.
Caroline Laichena, Sanlam General Insurance Ltd Chief Executive Officer handed over the cheque from Sanlam Kenya to the Covid Emergency Fund kitty.
